title: High Court reinstates 30% quota for descendants of freedom fighters.
detail: High Court reinstates 30% quota for descendants of freedom fighters.

title: Initial student protests begin at various universities.
detail: Initial student protests begin at various universities.

title: "Anti-Discrimination Student Movement" platform officially launched
detail: "Anti-Discrimination Student Movement" platform officially launched; nationwide protests begin.

title: Students announce "Bangla Blockade" starting from July 8.
detail: Students announce "Bangla Blockade" starting from July 8.

title: Appellate Division issues a four-week status quo on the High Court's judgment.
detail: Appellate Division issues a four-week status quo on the High Court's judgment.

title: PM Sheikh Hasina's "Razakar" comment triggers massive midnight protests at Dhaka University.
detail: PM Sheikh Hasina's "Razakar" comment triggers massive midnight protests at Dhaka University.

title: Chhatra League attacks protesters at Dhaka University and other campuses
detail: Chhatra League attacks protesters at Dhaka University and other campuses; hundreds injured.

title: Abu Sayed killed in Rangpur
detail: Abu Sayed killed in Rangpur; first deaths reported; movement turns into a mass uprising.

title: "Complete Shutdown" observed
detail: "Complete Shutdown" observed; Mir Mugdho killed; BTV building and other state properties set on fire; internet shutdown begins.

title: Curfew imposed
detail: Curfew imposed; military deployed; "Shoot-on-sight" orders issued.

title: Supreme Court (Appellate Division) rules 93% merit-based recruitment, reducing quota to 7%.
detail: Supreme Court (Appellate Division) rules 93% merit-based recruitment, reducing quota to 7%.

title: Government issues official gazette implementing the Supreme Court's verdict.
detail: Government issues official gazette implementing the Supreme Court's verdict.

title: Students announce a one-point demand: resignation of PM Sheikh Hasina and her cabinet.
detail: Students announce a one-point demand: resignation of PM Sheikh Hasina and her cabinet.

title: "Non-Cooperation Movement" begins
detail: "Non-Cooperation Movement" begins; massive clashes nationwide; over 100 deaths in a single day.

title: Long March to Dhaka
detail: "Long March to Dhaka"; PM Sheikh Hasina resigns and flees to India; protesters enter Ganabhaban.

title: Interim government led by Nobel Laureate Dr. Muhammad Yunus takes oath.
detail: Interim government led by Nobel Laureate Dr. Muhammad Yunus takes oath.
